results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's political content reduction policy, analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts to show how recommendation algorithms reduced the visibility of Italian parliamentarians while increasing engagement with extremist accounts.

results.title: La città incorona i protagonisti della promozione congressuale
results.snippet: News coverage of the Premio Rimini Mundi award ceremony, where Fabio Giglietto was appointed as an ambassador for promoting high-level international academic and scientific events in the region.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: News reporting on Giglietto's research into Meta's recommendation algorithms, highlighting how his findings were featured on Rai3's investigative show 'Report' and prompted a formal inquiry in the European Parliament.
